I added `GET /api/me/export` in `src/app/api/me/export/route.ts`. It returns the patient, appointments, messages (marked `sent` or `received` for the signed-in user) and general clinical notes. Non-patients get 403. I also added two repo queries, `listForUserExport` in `src/repos/messages.ts` and `listClinicalForPatient` in `src/repos/notes.ts`. The notes query reads only `clinical_notes`, so psychotherapy notes can't leak into the export. Each export writes an audit entry that records ids only.

Typecheck passes. I haven't run the test suite or added a test for the new endpoint.
